description:
Use this when the user wants to see their finished clips or saved photos, or needs a clip_id: "show me my
        clips", "what shorts did you make", "find my latest highlight", "my photos". Returns up to 50 per page (limit
        1-50; pass next_cursor as cursor for the next page) with each item's id, title, kind, source project and
        start/end seconds in the original video. kind: clips (default), photos, or all. Items past their retention
        date are not listed. A clip id works with get_download_link, edit_clip, style_clip, explain_clips,
        preview_frame and draft_post; a photo id with adjust_look, frame_clip, preview_frame and get_download_link.
        Not for: the long source videos (list_projects), a gallery with video players (show_clips), or why a clip was
        picked (explain_clips). Free and read only.
name: list_clips
title: List clips
